instanceRequest: I want to deposit USDC into Morpho's Steakhouse Prime USDC vault. build me the template and its report

role.en: The vault you deposit into: Steakhouse Prime USDC (steakUSDC), a Morpho Vault V2 curated by Steakhouse Financial
role.zh-TW: 你存入的 vault：Steakhouse Prime USDC（steakUSDC），Steakhouse Financial 管理的 Morpho Vault V2

text.en: Steakhouse's Prime Instant page lists Steakhouse Prime Instant USDC, Ethereum, Morpho v2, with this address
text.zh-TW: Steakhouse 的 Prime Instant 頁列出 Steakhouse Prime Instant USDC、Ethereum、Morpho v2 和這個地址

text.en: CoinGecko's coin steakhouse-usdc (Steakhouse USDC V2) is at this address
text.zh-TW: CoinGecko 的 steakhouse-usdc（Steakhouse USDC V2）就是這個地址

text.en: Morpho's API vaultV2ByAddress answers name Steakhouse Prime USDC, symbol steakUSDC, asset USDC, created at block 23671611
text.zh-TW: Morpho API 的 vaultV2ByAddress 回答名稱 Steakhouse Prime USDC、代號 steakUSDC、資產 USDC、建立於區塊 23671611

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract VaultV2 (solc 0.8.28); creation transaction 0x2ef63f2d9490f3c264cf5c4b0f0040a6a4c56866e026ac45f9fef835298a70cf, which the providers could not tie to the deployment; the factory answers isVaultV2 = true
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約 VaultV2（solc 0.8.28）；建立交易 0x2ef63f2d9490f3c264cf5c4b0f0040a6a4c56866e026ac45f9fef835298a70cf，providers 無法證明它是部署交易；工廠回答 isVaultV2 = true

role.en: The vault's only adapter and its liquidity adapter: a deposit is supplied through it into Morpho Blue markets
role.zh-TW: vault 唯一的轉接合約，也是流動性轉接合約：存款經由它供應到 Morpho Blue 市場

text.en: Morpho's API GET /v0/vaults-v2/1:<vault>/allocations answers adapter_address 0x2b9681015A1FA2225D1FC8ae40538d3D64C58290, kind morpho_market_v1_v2, the only adapter
text.zh-TW: Morpho API GET /v0/vaults-v2/1:<vault>/allocations 回答 adapter_address 0x2b9681015A1FA2225D1FC8ae40538d3D64C58290、種類 morpho_market_v1_v2，是唯一的轉接合約

text.en: Morpho's GraphQL API names it the vault's liquidityAdapter, type MorphoMarketV1
text.zh-TW: Morpho GraphQL API 說它是 vault 的 liquidityAdapter，類型 MorphoMarketV1

text.en: The Morpho app's vault page shows it only through scripts, so no program reads it there
text.zh-TW: Morpho app 的 vault 頁只用 script 顯示它，程式讀不到

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 (solc 0.8.28), created in block 24887994; the factory answers isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 = true and the vault isAdapter = true
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約 MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2（solc 0.8.28），建立於區塊 24887994；工廠回答 isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 = true，vault 回答 isAdapter = true

text.en: A large curated vault, but it grew from about 7 million to 61 million USDC in April 2026 and one holder has 22%.
text.zh-TW: 規模大的 curated vault，但 2026 年 4 月從約 700 萬暴增到 6,100 萬 USDC，最大持有者占 22%。

text.en: The vault held about 7.4 million USDC on 2026-03-31 and 61 million on 2026-04-30, about 116 million now. 745 addresses hold shares; the top 10 hold 54.07%, the largest 21.64%.

recommendation.en: Its size has been held for seven months; a large holder leaving can lower its idle liquidity, so plan your withdrawal.
recommendation.zh-TW: 這個規模已維持七個月；大戶撤出可能減少可提領的流動性，存入前想好何時提領。

text.en: The bundle pulls the approved USDC from the Safe
text.zh-TW: bundle 從 Safe 拉走已授權的 USDC

text.en: The bundle deposits it into the vault, shares minted to the Safe
text.zh-TW: bundle 存進 vault，份額鑄給 Safe
